problems.detail: Checks (1), (3), (4), (5) and (7) pass when run against the plan JSON, which is byte-identical to panel/final2/final.min.json. Migration has 208 rows for the 208 generated files, each once. The tarball holds 208 files including caches/index.spw, and 207 of them are byte-identical to HEAD. The 209th file on disk, resume/2026-09-30-direction.spw, is out of scope as intended. All 372 tree paths are unique and all 372 file anchors are unique within the cut. No path contains query|expr|ops|algos|experiments|style|phase. Every directory has an index.spw. No sibling directory name is a string prefix of another. Every migration target and every cross_link endpoint is a tree path, and no cross_link points up to an index. All 18 trails exist in the tree and every stop resolves to a planned anchor. Each of the 16 packages owns its files exactly once: no tree path is unowned or owned twice, owned counts equal new_files, and sizes run from 2505 to 3420 lines. Raw inputs are consistent with migration targets. All 16 forms and 52 domains are used, each on at least 2 files and at most N/3. Spot checks of source and calendar facts: 22 VS Code commands, 14 settings, Kotlin 2.4.10, Java 21, Gradle 9.5.0, builds 242 to 262.*, 513 commits at 229aedcf since 2026-01-08. Weekdays Thu Oct 1, Mon Oct 12, Thu Nov 26, Mon Dec 21, Fri Jan 1 and Mon Jan 4 are correct. Handle namespaces avoid the gate's REFLEXIVE_HANDLES prefixes.
problems.fix: none

problems.detail: Planned anchor spw_index (2026-09-30/spw/index.spw) duplicates #>spw_index in the canon root .spw/index.spw and in packages/spw-cli/templates/init/base/.spw/index.spw. The cut lives under .spw/, so LSP deixis, spw resolve and spw graph will see two homes. The cut gate checks anchor uniqueness only inside the cut dir, so it will not catch this. A second, smaller case: cut_contract and cut_vocabulary also exist in .agents/plans/caches-cut-2026-09-30/references/staging/ and will be duplicated repo-wide once the cut opens.
problems.fix: Rename the spw class index anchor, e.g. spw_class_index, and update the root bundle and any trail or bundle refs. Add a repo-wide anchor scan over .spw/, lib/ and .agents/ to the writer checklist or the gate. After the cut opens, remove the staging copies or mark them superseded.

problems.detail: The root and materials-and-engineering notes point writers to scratchpad/cut-staging/2026-09-30, but the plan stream (2026-10-01 06:22) says .agents/plans/caches-cut-2026-09-30/references/staging is the source of truth. Its contract.spw is newer and adds five hazards the scratchpad copy lacks: silent_errors, prefix_path, valence_capture, fragment_quotes, path_dialects. The scratchpad copy also still holds the tarball. vocabulary.spw, water.spw and the matter registries are identical in both copies.
problems.fix: Repoint every staged-file reference in the root and materials-and-engineering notes to .agents/plans/caches-cut-2026-09-30/references/staging/2026-09-30/. Root reconciles the domain, form and relation sets and the scope line from that newer contract.

problems.detail: The owner's shelf ^["quarantine"] (229aedcf) names nine files as do-not-cite. Migration marks only three as quarantine (common-deficiencies, nutritional-support-strategies, physiological taste). The other six are marked reframe: developmental-stages, circadian-and-metabolic-resilience, the three nursing files (pathophysiology, critical-care, ethical-care) and ecological-and-spatial-stewards. Those six appear as tree 'sources' (defined as 'draws on') and in the raw_inputs of plants-ecology-care and language-and-communities. The manifest action column would then contradict the owner's quarantine, and 'reframe' invites writers to import content.
problems.fix: Set action quarantine for all nine, with to = [provenance/harm-register.spw, successor file]. In the successor tree entries (development-as-succession, biological-clocks, nursing/pathophysiology-and-pharmacology, nursing/critical-care, nursing/ethics-and-presence, communities/commons-roles), list these raws as lineage_only, used for topic names only. Copy the nine-file list into contract.spw and add a grep or gate rule: no .spw/caches/ path inside any ~ ref or source: binding.

problems.detail: No package owns the post-write harm sweep. The risks section says only 'reviewers grep living/ and society/communities/'. That scope misses other health-adjacent surfaces: spw/perspectives/life-and-clinical-scientists.spw (form protocol, with example scripts), learning/secondary/family-and-community-wraparound.spw, making/broadcast/broadcast-cadence.spw (voice care), living/bioengineering/, spw/contraptions.spw and season/season-journal.spw. The spw-branch notes carry no harm-firewall line.
problems.fix: Make the whole-cut sweep a final stage owned by provenance-and-reference. It checks for imperatives, dose units, supplement and diet names, and remediation verbs, and logs hits to the harm register. Add to the spw-branch notes: example protocols in perspectives are non-clinical (lab bench or guideline-ledger shape), with no patient-care steps.

problems.detail: The 'no doses' rule collides with content the plan itself asks for. limiting-nutrients.spw tells iodization and folate-fortification history, which invites ppm and µg/100 g figures. guideline-currency-ledger.spw names vancomycin AUC 2020, which invites the 400-600 target. Writers will not know whether population policy parameters or guideline targets are allowed.
problems.fix: Add one rule to contract.spw. Population policy parameters are allowed only as sourced registry cells with as_of and framed as history or policy. Individual doses and therapeutic targets are never stated: name the guideline body and year only.

problems.detail: Four migration rows say errors go to errata, but their 'to' lists no errata file. The errata 'sources' lists and the provenance-and-reference raw_inputs also omit them, so the errata writer is never handed these raws. The four are: electrical-and-computer-engineering/taste (EUV, die size), materials-science/taste (mineral count, Si), physics-and-mechanical-engineering/taste (fatigue, viscosity) and neuroscience/taste (split-brain, neurogenesis, energy). errata-life-and-mind lists sources 'new'.
problems.fix: Add provenance/errata-technical.spw to the first three rows and provenance/errata-life-and-mind.spw to the neuroscience row. Add the four raws to those ledgers' sources and to the provenance-and-reference raw_inputs.

problems.detail: There is no explicit weave stage, and several pieces depend on files other packages have not written yet. Root writes first, but season/production-cadence links branch calendars owned by four packages. The errata and harm-register 'corrected-in anchor' columns need branch claim anchors. The 80 cross_links span packages. $%[] handles that read another package's namespace fail the gate until that cell exists. Only trails are given a finalize-later rule.
problems.fix: Wave 1: writers link only to the frozen file-level anchors in this tree and read only their own-namespace handles. A weave stage owned by root and provenance-and-reference then adds claim-level renvois, corrected-in anchors, cross-namespace handle reads, cross-package bundles, trail finals and the production-cadence links, and runs the gate last.

problems.detail: The manifest pins sha256 at 5acc5545, but .spw/caches/index.spw changed at 229aedcf (+30 lines adding the disclosure and quarantine frames), and it also differs from the generated tarball copy. The other 207 raw files are identical across the tarball, 5acc5545 and HEAD.
problems.fix: Pin at 229aedcf (HEAD). For index.spw, record three hashes: the generated tarball copy, 5acc5545 and 229aedcf.

problems.detail: The computed TARGET says to archive the raw dirs as a tarball and remove them. The plan keeps the shelf in place, which matches the owner: the resume note says 'A selection pins a coordinate and leaves the source in place', and plan-stream entries at 17:06 and 17:30 say the shelf stays as provenance and the owner confirmed the cut lives at .spw/caches/2026-09-30. Risk #1 still reads as an open authority question.
problems.fix: Record the decision in provenance/index.spw, citing the 17:06 and 17:30 stream entries as quoted strings. Reword risk #1 as resolved for location. Keep the owner check only for mounting or deploying elsewhere.

problems.detail: The domain slug spw is a string prefix of spw_theory and spw_perspectives. The anchor spw_theory_questions (domain spw, on spw/theory-questions.spw) reads as spw_theory's namespace, and its keystone anchors (spw_theory_questions_*) can clash with keystones in spw/theory/*.spw.
problems.fix: Rename it to spw_open_questions. Add a contract rule that anchors in domain spw never begin with spw_theory_ or spw_perspectives_, or make the domain slugs prefix-free.

problems.detail: Two archive patterns in the directive have no working mechanism. Luhmann's stable branching IDs: the contract has no rule that published anchors stay permanent, and the plan renames staged anchors (matter_water to materials_water), which is fine before opening but not after. Whole Earth 'access to tools': it appears only as history in reference-works-lineage, with no access field on kits or toolchain surfaces.
problems.fix: Contract adds an anchor-permanence rule: after the cut opens, anchors are never renamed or reused, and a rename leaves a stub anchor with a supersedes edge. Kits and author-toolchain gain an access: line (where to obtain the tool or record). archive-patterns-matrix states what is borrowed and what is declined.

problems.detail: The plan's principle says every trail crosses at least two classes. editor-truth crosses only spw plus the provenance apparatus. reference-library-lineage crosses only record plus panels and root files.
problems.fix: Insert computing_spec_lineage (formal) after editor_hosts_lsp in editor-truth. Insert spw_graph_idioms (spw) or generations_kit_interview (learning, Foxfire) before cut_vocabulary in reference-library-lineage.

problems.detail: The principle says 'bundles transclude only children's keystone anchors', yet each trail's ^bundle expands into a chapbook of cross-class anchors.
problems.fix: In contract.spw, exempt form trail from the child-only rule, or keep trail stops in a ^["stops"] frame and leave ^bundle child-only.

problems.detail: Scorecard PROMOTE verdicts have no landing surface for the owner. They are: jetbrains/instruments; jetbrains/lsp-client bits to .spw/tooling/intellij-plugin.spw; vscode/taste anti-echo to vscode-spw.spw quality_bar; podcasting year rows to a CS curriculum; and spw-resonance REGEN to docs/design/spw/design-research.spw. The plan correctly forbids canon edits, but nothing records these candidates.
problems.fix: Add a ^["promote"] queue to spw/plugin-theory.spw (host items) and spw/theory-questions.spw (design items). Each row names the source anchor, the target canon path and an owner question.

problems.detail: spw/hosts/vscode-commands-and-views.spw merges about 350 raw lines (features 124, instruments 117, views 109), the largest raw intake of any planned file, but it is missing from the plan's split-watch list. The gate warns at 320 lines.
problems.fix: Add it to the split watch, with a pre-planned split into commands-and-settings and views-and-instruments if it passes 300 lines.

problems.detail: The vscode-commands-and-views purpose says 'views (You Are Here, Roots, Memory, Spirit)'. Those are sections of the Workspace view (extensions/vscode-spw/src/views/workspace-tree.ts:455-470). package.json contributes two views, Workspace and Concepts. Concepts is omitted, and it is where the unapplied lens-visibility worktree lands.
problems.fix: Reword to: 'two views: Workspace (sections You Are Here, Roots, Memory, Spirit) and Concepts'.

problems.detail: Host and history rows cite file:line in extensions/, packages/ and .agents/plans/. The gate only warns when a ~ ref fragment points at a non-.spw target, and such refs make the graph hub on source files. Separately, the cut root index's door to the shelf scrutiny frame would be an up-link in spirit if written as a ~ ref: the gate exempts index files, and the owner reserves the shelf-to-cut route for themselves. The plan states no convention for either.
problems.fix: Contract rule: repo-source citations are quoted 'path:line' strings in source: or cites: bindings. ~ refs stay inside the cut. The shelf door is a quoted string, not a ~ ref.

problems.detail: The staged vocabulary keeps level 'mixed' (and vocabulary.spw itself declares #:level #!mixed, while the plan tree says practitioner), season 'off_season', era 'deep_time' and relation 'see'. Root's notes drop 'see' but not the others, and unused declared values will break the recurrence rule.
problems.fix: Root drops 'mixed', or keeps it only if two files use it, and sets vocabulary.spw to #:level #!practitioner. It audits the era and season values against planned use.

problems.detail: creators-and-platforms puts 'except ...' strings inside owns_dirs, so a tool that reads owns_dirs as paths will misparse them. Separately, migration labels tiktok-live/moderation-safety as keep, but the scorecard verdict is DROP (tree fit 1) and the content is regenerated with region and date qualifiers.
problems.fix: Move the exclusions to an excludes field. Relabel moderation-safety as reframe.
